text:
At handover, departure prep stood out in your clear note, and we are sorry that your pet travel arrangements did not meet the standard Aurelia Skyways requires. You reported a breakdown in coordination around check-in handling, carrier review, and the condition of support for your traveling companion, and the delay in response added to the strain. We are taking that seriously.

I am the shift coordinator on duty, and I have reviewed the desk log, the handoff notes, and the service sequence tied to the Companion Animal Travel Desk. The issue appears to have come from missed follow-through between teams during a busy cabin changeover, which is not acceptable when a pet's welfare and a traveler’s confidence are involved. Our expectation is prompt, respectful communication at every stage, and that was not delivered here.

Immediate corrective action is underway. I have asked the team to recheck the intake steps, confirm carrier readiness, and tighten the review of animal travel documents before any further acceptance at the counter. We are also reinforcing the escalation path so that when a concern is raised, it reaches the right desk without delay. If Hazel was affected, we want to make sure the record reflects the full sequence of events so we can respond properly and prevent repeat handling gaps.

We understand that a pet journey is not routine for the traveler, even when the rest of the flight operation is moving normally. That is why the Companion Animal Travel Desk must stay accurate, calm, and fast under pressure. Your complaint has been flagged for direct internal review, and the findings will be shared with the responsible leads so service recovery can be addressed on the same operational track.

Please accept our apology for the disruption and the extra worry it caused. We remain available to continue the review and to support any follow-up needed for your case. We are treating this as a priority and working to restore trust now.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
